statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome
The clinical indication note documents a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
CPT 93271 is indicated in the note for further diagnostic assessment of potential arrhythmic causes of the neurological symptoms and syncope
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and G45.9
The supplied note documents attempts at less intensive monitoring or their insufficiency
